observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor public street/square in front of a historic building with large wooden doors, sunny day, casual crowd walking past and musicians/clappers seated on steps
observation.dancers: mixed group of women performing in turns and together; between one and four women dancing at a time
observation.formation_and_space: group standing in a line clapping and singing while soloists dance in front of them on a wooden board
observation.posture: upright torso, spine held tall, chest open, knees slightly bent when stepping and stamping
observation.footwork: fast rhythmic foot stamping and heel strikes on the wooden board, shifting weight between feet on the beat; intricate rapid footwork cannot be fully resolved in detail
observation.arms_and_hands: expressive arm movements with fluid wrist rolls (floreo), arms raised or curved overhead, skirts held or manipulated with hands
observation.hips_and_torso: subtle torso bends and twists complementing arm movements, hips relatively still with focus on upper body and footwork
observation.levels_jumps_turns: upright level, occasional spins and turns executed on the spot, quick heel-toe foot stamps
observation.costume_and_props: women wear ruffled flamenco skirts (some solid black, some with polka dots), blouses, shawls (mantones) draped over shoulders or arms, flowers in hair; dancing on a small portable wooden board
observation.cannot_infer: exact footwork articulation and weight transfer details are obscured by low video resolution and camera distance

signature_moments.what: solo dancer performs rapid heel-tapping footwork on the wooden board while spinning and gesturing with arms overhead
dancer performs sharp stamping while executing a circular turn with fluid wrist rolls
three women dance in unison, stepping and turning with raised arms and ruffled skirts swirling
